debrief db-021
1) the actor f-a-l-s-i-f-i-e-d the r-e-p-t-i-l-e p-r-o-v-e-n-a-n-c-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s to c-r-e-a-t-e a f-a-k-e c-a-p-t-i-v-e-b-r-e-d h-i-s-t-o-r-y and l-e-f-t a s-t-u-b-b-e-d b-r-e-e-d-i-n-g l-o-g in the s-h-a-r-e-d f-o-l-d-e-r w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the g-e-n-e-t-i-c p-a-r-e-n-t-a-g-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
2) the actor f-o-r-g-e-d o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-c-e-i-p-t-s to b-r-i-d-g-e g-a-p-s in the a-n-i-m-a-l's p-a-p-e-r t-r-a-i-l and l-e-f-t a s-e-q-u-e-n-c-i-a-l s-t-a-m-p e-r-r-o-r on the n-e-w d-a-t-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-h-a-i-n o-f c-u-s-t-o-d-y a-u-d-i-t c-h-e-c-k
3) the actor f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d a p-e-r-m-i-t n-u-m-b-e-r to m-i-m-i-c a l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t a s-e-a-l-e-d a-r-c-h-i-v-e e-x-c-e-r-p-t of the e-x-p-i-r-e-d l-i-c-e-n-s-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l r-e-g-i-s-t-r-y l-o-o-k-u-p c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n
4) the actor p-u-b-l-i-s-h-e-d l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s u-s-i-n-g s-t-o-c-k p-h-o-t-o-g-r-a-p-h-s to i-m-p-r-e-s-s p-o-t-e-n-t-i-a-l b-u-y-e-r-s and l-e-f-t a t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p e-d-i-t i-n-d-i-c-a-t-o-r on the i-m-a-g-e m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-m-a-g-e a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
5) the actor u-s-e-d a c-l-o-n-e-d a-c-c-o-u-n-t to o-b-s-c-u-r-e the s-o-u-r-c-e of the i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y and l-e-f-t a d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e i-p a-d-d-r-e-s s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e on the t-r-a-d-e p-l-a-t-f-o-r-m w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-u-l-t-i-a-c-c-o-u-n-t c-o-r-r-e-l-a-t-i-o-n s-c-a-n c-h-e-c-k
